Chairman’s Statement


The year 2023 marks the start to comprehensively fulfill the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the CPC. Facing
the ever-present complex external environment, we have stayed on the course of high-quality development and
kept a focus on serving the development initiatives of China. We have adhered to the principles of pursuing growth
steadily, transforming while upholding fundamental principles, maintaining value orientation, keeping core business
strength and strengthening risk prevention. We have seen steady progress made in high quality development with
steadily developed business and an increasingly solidified managerial foundation.

Steady and positive business performance. 2023 is the first year that we released annual results under the
new accounting standards framework. Under the new standards, the total assets of the Group exceeded HK$1.5
trillion, increased by 14.2% over the 2022 year-end; total investment assets under management stood at around
HK$2.5 trillion; profit attributable to owners was HK$6.190 billion, increased by 44.1% over the Last Year. The
insurance business grew steadily. Insurance revenue and insurance service results (measured in RMB) of life
insurance both achieved a positive growth over the Last Year. TPL’s new business value achieved a positive growth
on a relatively high base with business quality continued to improve, and the persistency ratios of bancassurance
and individual agency channels continued to lead the industry for many consecutive years. TPI’s total premium
income for the first time broke through RMB30 billion. The P&C insurance and reinsurance have actively undergone
structural adjustment and quality improvement, and maintained underwriting profitability. The investment business
has made more investment income. The Group’s total managed assets and insurance fund within the Group under
management have both increased. The Group’s total and comprehensive investment yields both recorded higher
than those of the Last Year.

New achievements have been demonstrated in serving national strategies. We have fully incorporated
the assessment of serving the national strategy into the Group’s budget and KPIs of subsidiaries where serving
the national strategy and our own high-quality development are integrated. As of the end of 2023, the Group
has provided risk protection for the whole society of RMB137 trillion, representing an increase of 6.3% from
the beginning of the year. In particular, the premiums of social security insurance, agricultural insurance, green
insurance, catastrophe reinsurance and strategic emerging industry insurance all increased significantly. The Group
has actively served the “Belt and Road Initiative”, successfully held the Symposium on High-quality Belt and Road
Cooperation, and provided protection for 474 Belt and Road projects. Premiums from the Greater Bay Area has
hit the milestone of RMB50 billion. Following the business of “Northbound Travel for Hong Kong Vehicles”, we
wrote the first policy for “Northbound Travel for Hong Kong Vehicles” and maintained leading market share. We
supported over RMB1 trillion in serving the real economy and invested more than RMB60 billion in green finance.
TPG has received the highest grade in the Evaluation of Targeted Poor Areas Alleviation Performance among
Centrally-administrated State-owned Units for 2 consecutive years.




       China Taiping Insurance Holdings Company Limited
  8    2023 Annual Report
董事長致辭




                                          WANG Sidong   王思東
                                          Chairman      董事長



2023年是全面貫徹落實二十大精神的開局之年，面對複雜嚴峻的外部環境，全體太平人齊心協力、攻堅克難，緊緊圍
繞服務國家大局，以高質量發展為主綫，堅持穩中求進，堅持守正創新，堅持價值導向，堅持強基固本，堅持嚴防風險，
業務發展穩中有進，管理基礎不斷夯實，高質量發展邁出堅實步伐。

經營業績穩中向好。2023年是本公司首次按新會計準則發佈年度業績。新準則下，集團總資產突破1.5萬億港元，較
2022年末增長14.2%；管理投資資產規模近2.5萬億港元；股東應佔溢利61.90億港元，同比提升44.1%。保險板塊穩
中有進。壽險保險服務收入、保險服務業績（人民幣口徑下）均同比正增長；太平人壽新業務價值在較高基數上實現
正增長；業務品質持續優化，銀保、個險繼續率連續多年行業領先。太平財險保費規模首次突破300億元人民幣。產
險和再保險業務積極調結構、提質量，繼續保持承保盈利。投資板塊收益提升。集團管理投資資產與集團內保險資金
投資資產規模均實現增長。總投資收益率和綜合投資收益率取得了明顯改善。

服務國家戰略展現新作為。我們把服務國家戰略評價指標體系全面納入集團預算和子公司考核，與業務高質量發展
緊密結合。截至2023年底，為全社會提供風險保障137萬億元人民幣，較年初增長6.3%。其中，社會保障類保險、農
業保險、綠色保險、巨災再保險和戰略性新興產業保險的保費均明顯增長。積極服務「一帶一路」     ，舉辦服務高質量
共建「一帶一路」座談會，全年累計承保「一帶一路」沿綫項目474個。大灣區保費規模站穩500億元人民幣台階。繼「澳
車北上」後，「港車北上」又開出行業首單，並保持市場份額領先。服務實體經濟投入超1萬億元人民幣，綠色金融投
資超600億元人民幣。中國太平保險集團定點幫扶工作連續兩年獲中央單位考核「好」的最高等次評價。

4    Key Assumptions                                                  4   主要假設

     TPL has adopted the best estimate approach in setting the            太平人壽在設定計算內含價值及新業務價
     assumptions used in the calculation of its Embedded Value            值之假設時乃採納最佳估計方法。有關假
     and New Business Value. The assumptions have been based              設乃基於太平人壽之實際經驗，及參照中
     on the actual experience of TPL and certain benchmarks set           國之整體經濟狀況及其他壽險公司之經驗
     by referencing general PRC economic conditions and the               而設定之若干基準。
     experience of other life insurance companies.

     4.1 Risk discount rate                                               4.1 風險貼現率

         The risk discount rate represents the long-term, post-             風險貼現率乃指接受估值之投資者之
         tax cost of capital of the investor for whom the valuation         稅後長期資本成本，同時慮及中國有
         is made, together with an allowance for risk, taking into          關政治經濟環境等因素對風險作出調
         account of factors such as the political and economic              整。
         environment in the PRC.

         As calculated, the discount rate is equal to the risk-free         計算時，貼現率乃按無風險利率加風
         rate plus a risk premium. The risk free rate is based on           險溢價計算。無風險利率乃基於中國
         the PRC ten-year government bond and the risk premium              10年政府債券，而風險溢價反映與未
         reflects the risk associated with future cash flows,               來現金流有關之風險，包括所有在估
         including all of the risks which have not been considered          值時未有慮及之風險。
         in the valuation.

         The risk discount rate currently applied by TPL is 9.0%             太平人壽現時就其所有有效業務及新
         (2022:11.0%) for all in force and new business.                     業 務 所 採 納 之 風 險 貼 現 率 均 為9.0%
                                                                            （2022年：11.0%） 。

     4.2 Investment return                                                4.2 投資回報

         of 0.05% annually up to 5.0% and thereafter remain                  率為自4.8% 起，以後每年增加0.05%，

     (w) Borrowing costs                                                          (w) 借 款 費 用

          Borrowing costs directly attributable to the acquisition,                  購買、興建或生產合資格資產（即需經一
          construction or production of qualifying assets, which are assets          段長時間方能作擬定用途或出售之資產）
          that necessarily take a substantial period of time to get ready            而直接產生之借款費用一律列入該資產之
          for their intended use or sale, are added to the cost of those             成本，直至資產之大部分已可作擬定用途
          assets, until such time as the assets are substantially ready for          或出售時為止。
          their intended use or sale.

          Investment income earned on the temporary investment of                    特定借款用於合資格資產之前作為短暫投
          specific borrowings pending their expenditure on qualifying                資所賺取之投資收入於符合資本化之借款
          assets is deducted from the borrowing costs eligible for                   費用中扣除。
          capitalisation.

          All other borrowing costs are recognised in profit or loss in the          所有其他借款費用在實際產生費用之時確
          period in which they are incurred.                                         認於損益。

     (x) Finance lease receivables and unearned finance                           (x) 應 收 融 資 租 賃 款 和 未 實 現 融 資 收 益
         income

          A finance lease is a lease that transfers substantially all the            將租賃資產的所有權所附帶的幾乎所有的
          risks and rewards incidental to ownership of the leased assets             風險和回報轉讓給承租人的租賃為融資租
          to the lessee. At the commencement of the lease term, the                  賃。在租賃開始日，本集團將租賃開始日最
          Group recognises the minimum lease payments receivable                     低租賃收款額作為應收融資租賃款的入賬
          by the Group as a finance lease receivable and records the                 價值，確認應收融資租賃款，並同時記錄未
          unguaranteed residual value at the same time. The difference               擔保餘值，將 (a) 累計之最低租賃收款額及
          between (a) the aggregate of the minimum lease payments                    未擔保餘值之和(b) 與其現值之和的差額記
          and the unguaranteed residual value and (b) their present value            錄為未實現融資租賃收益，應收融資租賃
          is recognised as unearned finance income. Finance lease                    款減去未實現融資租賃收益的淨額在合併
          receivable net of unearned finance income is recorded in the               資產負債表中確認。
          consolidated statement of financial position.

          Unearned finance income is amortised during the lease term                 未實現融資租賃收益在租賃期內各個期間
          using effective interest method.                                           採用有效利率法進行分配。

     (y) Leasing                                                                  (y) 租 賃

          A contract is, or contains, a lease if the contract conveys the            如果合同轉移已識別資產在一段時間內的
          right to control the use of an identified asset for a period of time       使用權利以換取對價，則合同為租賃或包
          in exchange for consideration.                                             含租賃。

          For contracts entered into or modified or arising from business            對於在初次應用之日或之後訂立，修改或
          combinations on or after the date of initial application, the Group        因業務合併而產生的合同，本集團在適用
          assesses whether a contract is or contains a lease based on                之初，修改日或收購日根據香港財務報告
          the definition under HKFRS 16 at inception, modification date              準則第16號的定義評估合同是否為租賃或
          or acquisition date, as appropriate. Such contract will not be             包含租賃。除非隨後更改了合同的條款和
          reassessed unless the terms and conditions of the contract are             條件，否則不會重新評估該合同。
          subsequently changed.

                 largely offset by similar exposures arising from insurance                    同產生的類似風險所抵消。本集團的
                 and reinsurance contracts. The nature of the Group’s                          業務性質和資產負債匹配流程意味著
                 business and asset-liability matching processes means                         其面臨代表股東權益的淨資產的市場

                 shareholders’ equity. Interest rate risk also arise from                      保也會產生利率風險，只要這些擔保

           (ii) Credit risk                                                            (ii) 信 用 風 險

               Credit risk is the risk of economic loss resulting from                    信用風險是指由於債務人未能在到期
               the failure of one of the obligors to make full payment of                 時全額支付本金或利息而導致經濟損
               principal or interest when due.                                            失的風險。

               The Group is exposed to credit risks primarily associated                  本集團面臨的信用風險主要與以攤餘
               with investments in debt investments measured at                           成本計量和以公允價值計量且其變動
               amortised cost and FVOCI, and finance lease receivables.                   計入其他綜合收益的債務投資、和應
               The statutory deposits, pledged and restricted bank                        收金融租賃款有關。本集團對法定存
               deposits, cash and cash equivalent and amounts due                         款、已抵押及受限制銀行存款、現金及
               from group companies and other assets are subjected to                     現金等價物、應收集團內公司款項和
               ECL requirement, the identified impairment allowance was                   其他資產確定其預期信用損失，已識
               immaterial.                                                                別的其減值準備金額不重大。

               The Group internally grades financial assets based on the                  本集團根據信貸質量、風險特徵和本
               credit quality, risk characteristics and the Group’s internal              集團的內部信貸控制政策對金融資產
               credit control policy.                                                     進行內部評級。

               Where applicable, these internal credit ratings are aligned                如適用，這些內部信用評級與外部信
               to external credit rating companies such as Moody’s and                    用評級機構，如穆迪和中央國債登記
               China Central Depository & Clearing Co., Ltd.                              結算有限責任公司的結果一致。

               Credit risk management practices                                           信用風險管理

               The risk level of the various investment sectors is                        本集團不斷監測各個投資部門的風險
               continuously monitored with the investment mix adjusted                    水平，並對投資組合進行相應調整。就
               accordingly. In respect of the debt securities and debt                    人壽保險和財產及意外傷害保險業務
               products invested by life insurance and property and                       在中國投資的債務證券而言，由投資
               casualty insurance business in the PRC, the investment                     委員會管理的《投資程序手冊》包括
               procedures manual, which is managed by an investment                       中國國家金融監督管理總局要求的發
               committee, includes the minimum acceptable credit                          行人的最低可接受信用評級。任何不
               rating of the issuers as required by the NFRA. Any non-                    符合或違反手冊的行為都將被跟進，
               compliance or violation of the manual will be followed up                  並立即採取糾正措施。
               and rectification action will be taken immediately.

               The Group does not have any significant concentration of                   由於投資組合多元化，本集團不存在
               counterparty credit risk arising from the investments in debt              因債務證券投資而產生的交易對手信
               securities since the investment portfolio is well diversified.             用風險的重大集中。

               The credit risk associated with reinsurance companies is                   再保險公司的信用風險是通過定期評

               Judgement of significant increase in credit risk                               信用風險顯著增加的評估

               In determining whether the credit risk of a financial asset                    本集團評估初始確認及每個報告日，
               has increased significantly since initial recognition, the                     均會評估金融資產的信用風險自初始
               Group evaluates the credit risk at initial recognition and also                確認後是否顯著增加時。
               whether there is any significant increase in credit risk for
               each reporting period.

               The Group considers individual financial asset or financial                    本集團考慮個別金融資產或具有類似
               assets with similar credit risk characteristics to determine                   信用風險特徵的金融資產，通過比較

           (iii) Liquidity risk                                                         (iii) 流 動 性 風 險

               The Group has to meet daily calls on its cash resources,                     本集團須滿足其現金資源的每日調用，
               notably from claims arising from its life insurance contracts,               尤其是其人壽保險合同、財產保險合
               property and casualty insurance contracts and reinsurance                    同及再保險合同產生的賠款費用，因
               contracts. There is, therefore, a risk that cash will not be                 此存在現金不足以償還到期負債的風
               available to settle liabilities when due.                                    險。

               The Group manages this risk by formulating policies and                      本集團透過制定流動資金管理的政策
               general strategies of liquidity management to ensure that                    及一般策略管理該風險，以確保本集
               the Group can meet its financial obligations in normal                       團滿足正常情況下的財務需求及備存
               circumstances and that an adequate stock of high-quality                     充裕的高質素流動資產，以應對可能
               liquid assets is maintained in order to contain the possibility              產生的流動資金危機。
               of a liquidity crisis.

               Apart from liquidity management and regulatory compliance,                   除流動資金管理及監管遵從外，本集
               the Group always strives to maintain a comfortable liquidity                 團致力於留存適度的流動資金緩衝額
               cushion as a safety net for coping with unexpected large                     作為應對意料之外的大筆資金需求的
               funding requirements and to maintain a contingency plan to                   安全措施，以及制定應急計劃以應付
               be enacted should there be a company specific crisis.                        公司的特定危機。

     (a) Nature or purpose of reserves                                              (a)   儲備目的或性質

          (i)   Capital reserve                                                           (i)   資本儲備

                The capital reserve represents the differences between the                      資本儲備是指所收購目標權益、目標
                net assets value of the target interests, target assets and                     資產及負債之資產淨值與本公司作為
                liabilities acquired and the fair value of the shares issued by                 收購代價所發行股份公允價值的差額。
                the Company as consideration for the acquisition.

          (ii) Merger reserve                                                             (ii) 合 併 儲 備

                Merger reserve represents the difference in (i) the fair value                  合併儲備代表以下兩者之差異 (i) 作為
                of the shares issued as a consideration paid to TPG and                         支付予中國太平保險集團及中國太平
                TPG (HK) and (ii) the share capital and share premium of                        保險集團（香港）代價所發行的股份之
                the equity interests and the carrying value of certain assets                   公允價值，及 (ii) 股本權益的股本及股
                acquired which were all under common control of TPG and                         份溢價和收購前及收購後均由中國太
                TPG (HK) before and after the acquisition.                                      平保險集團及中國太平保險集團（香
                                                                                                港）共同控制的若干資產之賬面價值。

          (iii) Exchange reserve                                                          (iii) 匯 兌 儲 備

                The exchange reserve is comprised of all of the foreign                         匯兌儲備包括換算所有中國香港以外
                exchange differences arising from the translation of the                        業務賬項至本集團之呈報貨幣所產生
                financial statements of Group entities that has functional                      的匯兌差異。此儲備根據有關附註1(v)
                currency different from the Group’s presentation currency.                      所披露的會計政策處理。
                The reserve is dealt with in accordance with the accounting
                policy disclosed in Note 1(v).

          (iv) Fair value reserve                                                         (iv) 公 允 價 值 儲 備

                The fair value reserve is comprised of the cumulative net                       公允價值儲備包括根據有關附註1(g)(ii)
                change in the fair value of debt investments and equity                         所披露的會計政策處理於報告期末以
                investments at FVOCI held at the end of the reporting                           公允價值計量且其變動計入其他綜合
                period and is dealt with in accordance with the accounting                      收益的債務投資和權益投資的累計公
                policy disclosed in Note 1(g)(ii).                                              允價值變動淨額。

          (v) Insurance finance reserve                                                   (v) 保 險 財 務 儲 備

                The insurance finance reserve comprises the cumulative                          保險財務儲備包括根據有關附註1(c)
                insurance finance income and expenses recognised in OCI                         由在其他綜合收益中確認的保險財務
                (see Note 1(c)).                                                                收入和保險財務費用組成。

          (vi) Revaluation reserve                                                        (vi) 重 估 儲 備

                The revaluation reserve represents the revaluation of                           重估儲備代表額外購入太平財險時，
                fair value of the assets and liabilities from the additional                    有關過往持有太平財險權益為聯營公
                acquisition of TPI relating to previously held interest in TPI                  司的資產及負債之公允價值重估。此
                as associates and the revaluation of fair value of certain                      外，亦包括若干物業由土地及建築物
                properties from land and buildings to investment properties.                    重新分類至投資物業之公允價值重估。

     affect the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenues and           之資產、負債、收入及開支，以至相關披露之金
     expenses as well as the related disclosures. Changes in assumptions        額。更改假設或會對更改假設之期間的財務報
     may have a significant impact on the financial statements in the           表造成重大影響。引致下個財政年度內之資產
     periods where the assumptions are changed. The estimates and               及負債之賬面值有重大調整主要風險之估計及

     adjustment to the carrying amounts of assets and liabilities within the

     (a) Impairment of goodwill and intangible assets                           (a)   商譽及無形資產減值
